migration.problem: The public headers still select the old printf-based paths, so callers do not yet receive the component-tested engine’s shortest floating output, checked failures and counted transport.
migration.design: Select the checked engine through the public wrapper while preserving macro spellings, static formatters and built-in SYCL formatters. The legacy oracle fixtures now compare full output and fmt shortest values; null strings compare against fmt rejection rather than glibc text. These fixtures are the retained qualified regressions, introduced here with the public behavior they require.
